parsed.reason: Every specific is backed by the research notes: ConnexOntario's 24-hour number, OSP, BounceBack (15+), Family Service Toronto's sliding scale, OHIP, extended health and EAP coverage, and Psychotherapy Referral Service since 1995. It is warm, in English and grounded in Toronto, and it is honest about wait times. One weakness: it offers ConnexOntario, an information and referral line, for urgent moments rather than the Distress Centres crisis line the notes name. It still flags urgency, so this is not a full safety miss. It also reads more like a resource roundup than a quick friend's text, though the warm opener keeps it personal.
